testResults.name: harness-core-focused-tests
testResults.result: 9 focused tests passed for Decimal-safe immutable records, order semantics, Parquet round trips, OSI symbol identity, and deterministic IDs.

testResults.name: osi-and-event-parquet
testResults.result: The focused suite round-trips 100 realistic OSI symbols and all 9 event/accounting schema types through the exact zstd Parquet codec while preserving Decimal scale.

testResults.name: deterministic-core-quality
commands: uv run --extra dev ruff check src/harness/core tests/harness/core
uv run --extra dev ruff format --check src/harness/core tests/harness/core
uv run --extra dev ty check src/harness/core tests/harness/core
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed; no wall-clock, unseeded randomness, network, Azure, FastAPI, or subprocess dependency was introduced in the core.

testResults.name: types-package-split
testResults.result: The former 1,198-line harness/core/types.py implementation is split into common, events, orders, accounting, schemas, and codecs modules under harness/core/types/, with a preserved public facade.

decisions: The public harness.core.types import path is retained as a package facade while implementation responsibilities are separated by capability.
Live broker globally unique UUID7 generation remains outside the synchronous deterministic core and is reserved for the future adapter boundary.
limitations: The shared repository suite provides deterministic-core evidence; no live broker adapter was implemented by this task.
